item.title: Fukushuuya
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GrayZone
  • 発売日: 2015-08-12
  • スコア: 6.15/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 復讐屋
  • 英語名: Fukushuuya

别名

  • Revenge For Hire

あらすじ

I’m a Revenger.

You may think you know me… a mercenary who’ll do bad things

for whoever’s paying. But I’m actually a specialist.

I, Akito Blackcastle, provide faithful re-enactments of my clients’ fantasies.

Keiko Sakurai - a rich sheltered girl

Rei Minase - a swimming instructor

Misuzu Misugi - a waitress

Sayaka Koyama - a shrine maiden
